messages:
raj: Heads-up - I finished the first quant sweep for pelagic-14b embeddings. Per-tensor int8 shows decent latency gains but we see an unexpected bump in false-neighbor rate and recall@10 regressions on cross-lingual holdouts. Posting quick numbers + notes.

maria: Oof. Paste the metrics and which eval split.

raj: Eval = semantic-suite-multilang (40k queries: en/zh/es/fr/ar), seeds 7/13/21. Median of 3 runs.

```
config                r@1     r@5     r@10    fnr(%)*   silhouette_k5   p95_ms
pelagic:fp16          0.885   0.947   0.960   0.15      0.428           48ms
pelagic:int8-pt       0.876   0.942   0.953   0.42      0.403           38ms
pelagic:int8-pc       0.883   0.945   0.959   0.18      0.423           39ms
pelagic:int8-pc+clamp 0.884   0.946   0.959   0.16      0.425           40ms
*fnr = false-neighbor rate = % queries where top5 changed but none remain correct
```

raj: Notes: per-tensor (pt) int8 increases fnr ~0.27pp and drops r@10 ~0.007. Per-channel (pc) nearly closes the gap. The clamp tweak (clamp=0.92 on attn_out) stabilizes silhouette.

june: Interesting. Where is the cross-lingual impact concentrated? zh/es or ar?

raj: Breakdown (r@10 fp16 -> int8-pt):
- en: 0.964 -> 0.956 (-0.008)
- zh: 0.932 -> 0.918 (-0.014)
- es: 0.958 -> 0.952 (-0.006)
- fr: 0.947 -> 0.939 (-0.008)
- ar: 0.915 -> 0.890 (-0.025) <- biggest hit on ar (rare tokens + right-to-left quirks)

vik: Could be tokenization alignment + quant scale mismatch on language-specific vocab embeddings. Did you inspect embedding norm distribution by language?

raj: Yup - avg L2 norm drop for ar tokens ~3.2% under per-tensor int8, while en ~1.0%. Also per-layer drift concentrated in output projection layers of the last transformer block.

maria: Can you share commands/config you ran? Ops will need to repro. Also we should compute knn-stability-index and id-flip distribution, not just fnr.

raj: Command snippets: 
```
# per-tensor baseline
rbw-quant --model pelagic-14b --mode pt8 --calib 2048 --out runs/pelagic/pt8/
# per-channel
rbw-quant --model pelagic-14b --mode pc8 --calib 2048 --out runs/pelagic/pc8/
# per-channel + clamp
rbw-quant --model pelagic-14b --mode pc8 --clamp 0.92 --calib 2048 --out runs/pelagic/pc8_clamp/
rbw-eval --model-run runs/pelagic/pc8_clamp/ --eval semantic-suite-multilang --k 10 --out evals/4812345678/
```

raj: Added knn-stability-index (KSI) = fraction of queries where overlap(topK_fp16, topK_quant) >= 0.8. Results: fp16->pt8 KSI=0.83, fp16->pc8 KSI=0.90. id-flip (top1 lost) rates: pt8=0.48% pc8=0.12%.

june: Good. Ops: can we reserve a dedicated window to re-run pc8 with asymmetric calibrations and a multilingual token-level clamp trial? Want larger calib (8k) and per-lang calib passes. @ops-bot

ops-bot: Reservation placed: dedicated-ml-1, 4xA100, 5h window tomorrow 19:00-00:00 UTC, job pelagic-4812345678. Quota assigned to raj. Artifacts path: /artifacts/pelagic-4812345678/. :white_check_mark:

maria: After rerun, please produce: 1) per-lang recall@k, 2) fnr & id-flip histograms, 3) KSI bootstrapped CIs, 4) UMAP diffs for ar/zh clusters, 5) per-layer drift table. We'll use these to decide whether pc8+clamp is safe for canary.

vik: Also add a quick nearest-neighbor semantic-check: sample 2k queries from ar and compute human-labeled relevance for top3 neighbors for fp16 vs pc8 to sanity-check fnr meaning. Small crowd-run.

raj: Will queue jobs and the human-review task. If asymmetric per-channel + per-lang calib reduces ar fnr to <0.2% and id-flip <0.15%, propose a 3-day 5% canary on staging with alerts on short/rare-lang gates.

eval-bot: FYI used metric pack "knn-stability-v2" for KSI and uploaded initial plots to https://redwood.internal/evals/4812345678/plots.zip

maria: Great. One softer ask: log the tokenization distribution used during calib (per-lang token ids counts) - helps us reason about calibration bias.

raj: Will include token-count dumps. TL;DR: per-tensor int8 gives latency wins but cross-lingual tail suffers (esp ar). Per-channel + small clamp mostly recovers quality. Rerun with larger calib and per-lang passes scheduled on dedicated GPUs. Will post updated metrics + UMAPs here when done. :satellite:
